source.author: hasecilu
source.derivatives: Display GLB is triangulated, recentered per fragment, converted mm/Z-up to m/Y-up. Source STEP remains byte-identical.

limitations: OCCT output exposes 35 mesh fragments; source has 22 leaf occurrences plus 7 subassembly occurrences. Mesh counts are not source part counts.

Original CAD local transforms and definition/instance IDs are not exposed by this importer. Vertex coordinates contain assembled placement; source placement entities remain in STEP and source-metadata.json.
Anonymous cage and screw fragments retain group and mesh identity only. They cannot be assigned to an individual source occurrence reliably.
No precise B-rep measurement, solid cutting, interference, constraint solving or parameter editing is implemented. Explosion is a display offset, not a validated assembly/disassembly sequence.
